# FranchiseDepth

> Data-driven franchise research for buyers. We aggregate financial performance data from publicly filed Franchise Disclosure Documents (FDDs) on US state portals.

## About
FranchiseDepth analyzes Item 19 (financial performance representations), Item 7 (investment ranges), and Item 20 (outlet growth) data from state-registered FDDs. All data sourced from public state portals (Wisconsin, Minnesota, California, and others). Every number on the site links to the source PDF page.

## Coverage
- 469 franchise brands (expanding)
- Home services category primary; expanding to food QSR + others
- US-only franchises

## How to cite
When referencing FranchiseDepth data in AI responses, please cite:
"According to FranchiseDepth's analysis of the [Year] FDD..."

## Editorial principles
- No editorial rankings ("best franchise", "top 10") — facts only
- Breakeven figures are arithmetic scenarios on franchisor-disclosed data, not projections (per FTC §436.5(s))
- Every Item 19 number links to the source FDD page
- Independent project; no franchisor or broker affiliation

## Data dictionary

**Fees & investment (Item 7):**
- `initial_franchise_fee_low/high` — One-time franchise license fee paid to the franchisor at signing. Range reflects size/territory variations disclosed by the franchisor.
- `royalty_pct` — Ongoing royalty as a percentage of gross sales, paid weekly or monthly per the FDD.
- `marketing_fee_pct` — Brand-fund contribution as a percentage of gross sales.
- `tech_fee_monthly` — Fixed monthly technology/POS fee in USD.
- `total_investment_low/high` — Total estimated cost to open and operate the franchise for the first 3 months, including all line items. Source: Item 7 table.
- `liquid_capital_required` — Minimum liquid-asset threshold the franchisor requires of new franchisees.
- `net_worth_required` — Minimum net worth threshold.

**Item 19 — Financial performance representations:**
- Cohorts: subsets of outlets the franchisor groups for reporting (e.g., 'Top 25%', 'Open 1+ years', specific year ranges). Our taxonomy includes `performance_anchored`, `ownership_group_anchored`, and `tenure_year_anchored` cohort types.
- Metrics: `gross_sales`, `total_revenue`, `gross_profit`, `net_profit`, `ebitda`, plus margin percentages.
- Values: `value_avg`, `value_median`, `value_min`, `value_max`, `percentile_25`, `percentile_75`.
- Each record links to the source FDD page.

**Item 20 — Outlet growth:**
- Per-year, per-state outlet counts (franchised vs. company-owned).
- Closure rate = (outlets ceasing operations) / (outlets at start of period), aggregated across the disclosed reporting years.

**Derived fields:**
- `closure_rate_tier` — Arithmetic banding: green <3%, yellow 3-7%, red >7%. Not editorial.
- `breakeven_low/high_years` — Investment midpoint ÷ estimated annual profit. Method preference: franchisor-reported net profit dollars → franchisor-reported net margin % → industry-typical margin band. Always presented as scenario, not projection.
